subject.title: Fix native hook fallback and suppress duplicate session lock replies

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally allow an unavailable generated Codex `PreToolUse` command to exit successfully only when registration recorded that no before-tool policy existed?
rationale: This is a security-sensitive product contract: the change deliberately distinguishes an inert registration from an unknown or active policy, and the required direct Codex runtime inspection was unavailable for this review.

options.title: Verify and retain the narrow no-op mode
options.body: Confirm the exact Codex runtime contract, add live proof for both policy states, and retain the generated-only `noop` marker if active-policy failures remain fail-closed.

options.title: Keep unavailable PreToolUse fail-closed
options.body: Reject the no-op fallback and retain the prior fail-closed behavior for every unavailable PreToolUse command.

recommendation.title: Verify and retain the narrow no-op mode
recommendation.body: Confirm the exact Codex runtime contract, add live proof for both policy states, and retain the generated-only `noop` marker if active-policy failures remain fail-closed.
